question: Counted from the decision to launch a review of existing price zone layouts, how long do the participating TSOs have to submit a joint proposal to maintain or amend the layout?
reply: {"gold_answers": "yes", "gold_reason": "Article 32(4)(b)(iii) of Regulation 2015/1222 says the participating TSOs submit a joint proposal to maintain or amend the bidding zone configuration within 15 months of the decision to launch a review.", "other_articles": [{"doc_id": "reg_2019_943_art14", "answers": "partially", "why": "Article 14(6) gives a different deadline (12 months) counted from approval of the methodology and assumptions, not from the decision to launch the review. It could confuse a reader but does not answer the question as asked."}], "ambiguity": "minor", "ambiguity_reason": "Article 14(6) of Regulation 2019/943 sets a different deadline (12 months after methodology approval), but the question's wording \"counted from the decision to launch a review\" matches only Article 32 of Regulation 2015/1222.", "suggested_fix": ""}

verdict.gold_reason: Article 32(4)(b)(iii) of Regulation 2015/1222 says the participating TSOs submit a joint proposal to maintain or amend the bidding zone configuration within 15 months of the decision to launch a review.

other_articles.why: Article 14(6) gives a different deadline (12 months) counted from approval of the methodology and assumptions, not from the decision to launch the review. It could confuse a reader but does not answer the question as asked.

verdict.ambiguity_reason: Article 14(6) of Regulation 2019/943 sets a different deadline (12 months after methodology approval), but the question's wording "counted from the decision to launch a review" matches only Article 32 of Regulation 2015/1222.
